scope: Qwen Core/Reliability <-> Notion Agent delegation boundary

facts: Notion validate_delegation_request accepts any non-empty stripped task_id and does not cap it at 80 ASCII-safe characters.
Therefore valid Notion target=qwen requests such as child/1, задача-1, or an 81-character ASCII id are rejected by Qwen if passed through unchanged.
Qwen persisted coding subagents mark potential post-side-effect failures uncertain and block automatic retry unless retryUncertain=true.
Notion DelegationAdapter currently returns only text; DelegationResult has no uncertain/resumed/code/persisted identity fields.
Notion SubagentLifecycle always releases task_id in finally after exceptions/cancellation, and an existing test explicitly expects cancelled task identity to be reusable.

A future Qwen adapter must therefore not treat a Notion retry as a fresh Qwen task. It must derive stable Qwen persisted batch/task identity from the canonical delegated identity, preserve Qwen uncertain as a fail-closed result/error, and never set retryUncertain automatically.

offline_reproduction.shape: Qwen-like adapter performs a write then raises error with uncertain=true; Notion lifecycle releases the task id; the same request is accepted again.

recommended_adapter_contract.task_id_mapping: derive a deterministic Qwen SAFE_TASK_ID from canonical Notion task_id; do not pass arbitrary raw ids through
recommended_adapter_contract.batch_id_mapping: derive a deterministic Qwen SAFE_BATCH_ID from target + parent_turn_id + task_id (or stable delegated conversation identity); reuse it across retries/restarts
recommended_adapter_contract.retry_policy: retryUncertain must remain false/default unless an explicit owner-level action chooses otherwise
recommended_adapter_contract.result_policy: Qwen uncertain/running-recovered state must not be flattened into ordinary text success or a generic retryable error
recommended_adapter_contract.parent_identity: return/report the original canonical Notion task_id even if the internal Qwen-safe id is encoded

change_policy: No product file was changed. The owner of the future Qwen adapter should add the regression before wiring provider traffic.
